run_hydra_experiment: run a BenchMARL experiment with VMAS tasks using Hydra configuration for algorithm and task selection
load_experiment_from_hydra: create an Experiment object from a Hydra DictConfig and task name using load_experiment_from_hydra
run_experiment_method: run the loaded Experiment object by calling its run method to execute the multi-agent training loop
get_hydra_runtime_choices: get the selected task and algorithm names from HydraConfig runtime choices during experiment execution
print_omegaconf_yaml: print the loaded Hydra configuration as YAML using OmegaConf.to_yaml for debugging and verification
